\begin{infobox}
Work through the four parts in order: read each section, practise the matching Duolingo units, work the book-only topics that Duolingo does not cover, then finish the chapter. Duolingo units are grouped by lane (a grade or a topic in the app) and listed in the order the app shows them, so you can follow one lane from top to bottom. \textbf{full} = the unit practises the section's main skill, \textbf{partial} = part of it, \textbf{prereq} = a warm-up from an earlier grade.
\end{infobox}
\textbf{In this chapter:} Grade 11 covers exponentials and logarithms almost section by section. Duolingo stops at growth and decay, so the Gaussian, logistic, and logarithmic models of 3.5 come from the book only.

\section{3.\quad Section by section}
For each section: what Duolingo covers (the units are ticked off in part 2) and the book-only topics to work in the textbook. Tick each book-only topic once you have worked examples of it.
\subsection{3.1 Exponential Functions and Their Graphs\tagright{p. 216}}
Grades 9 and 11 both cover exponential functions; grade 11 adds the natural base and continuous growth. Compound interest formulas are book only.\par
{\small \textit{Duolingo:} \textbf{Grade 9:} 70. Exponential function tables (prereq); 71. Exponential function graphs (prereq); 72. Exponential function equations (prereq)\\ \textbf{Grade 11:} 38. Exponential function tables (full); 39. Exponential function graphs (full); 40. Exponential function equations (full); 41. Exponential growth (full); 42. Exponential decay (full); 48. Intro to the natural base (full); 49. Continuous growth models (full)\\ \textbf{Algebraic Graphing:} 15. Intro to exponential functions (full); 16. Exponential graphs and equations (full); 19. The natural base, e (full)}\par
{\small\textit{Book only:}}
\begin{checks}
  \item Compound interest, n times per year and continuously
\end{checks}
\subsection{3.2 Logarithmic Functions and Their Graphs\tagright{p. 227}}
Grade 11 covers logarithms, their graphs, and the natural logarithm nearly one to one with the section.\par
{\small \textit{Duolingo:} \textbf{Grade 11:} 50. Intro to logarithms (full); 51. Logarithm value (full); 56. Intro to logarithmic functions (full); 57. Logarithmic functions in base 10 (full); 58. Logarithmic functions in base 2 (full); 59. Logarithmic function graphs (full); 60. Logarithmic function intercepts (full); 61. The natural logarithm (full); 62. Natural logarithm graphs (full)\\ \textbf{Grade 12:} 16. Undo exponentials (partial)\\ \textbf{Algebra:} 18. Logarithms (full)\\ \textbf{Algebraic Graphing:} 20. Logarithmic functions (full); 21. Logarithmic function graphs (full); 22. Natural logarithmic function (full)}\par
\subsection{3.3 Properties of Logarithms\tagright{p. 237}}
Fully covered: product, quotient, and power rules plus change of base in grade 11, consolidated in grade 12.\par
{\small \textit{Duolingo:} \textbf{Grade 11:} 52. Product rule (full); 53. Quotient rule (full); 54. Power rule (full); 55. Change of base formula (full)\\ \textbf{Grade 12:} 15. Properties of logarithms (full)\\ \textbf{Algebra:} 19. Product and quotient rules (full); 20. Properties of logarithms (full)}\par
\subsection{3.4 Exponential and Logarithmic Equations\tagright{p. 244}}
Exponential equations are covered well; logarithmic equations and checking for extraneous solutions are lighter in the app.\par
{\small \textit{Duolingo:} \textbf{Grade 11:} 63. Solve exponential equations using logarithms (full); 64. Solve base e equations using logarithms (full)\\ \textbf{Grade 12:} 16. Undo exponentials (prereq)\\ \textbf{Algebra:} 21. Solve logarithmic and exponential equations (full)}\par
{\small\textit{Book only:}}
\begin{checks}
  \item Logarithmic equations
  \item Checking for extraneous solutions
\end{checks}
\subsection{3.5 Exponential and Logarithmic Models\tagright{p. 255}}
Only exponential growth and decay models are covered. Gaussian, logistic, and logarithmic models are book only.\par
{\small \textit{Duolingo:} \textbf{Grade 11:} 41. Exponential growth (partial); 42. Exponential decay (partial); 49. Continuous growth models (partial)\\ \textbf{Algebraic Graphing:} 18. Exponential growth and decay (partial)}\par
{\small\textit{Book only:}}
\begin{checks}
  \item Gaussian models
  \item Logistic growth models
  \item Logarithmic models (pH, Richter scale, decibels)
\end{checks}
